planets.name: GJ 143 b
planets.description: GJ 143 b crosses its star every 35.6 days and is 2.6 times as wide as Earth, found in 2019.

text.card: GJ 143 b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around GJ 143. Its orbit and size follow Dragomir et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
